conclusion: The test read coordinates during progress motion. A native-animation control reproduces stale pointer coordinates with unchanged installed player bytes; awaiting actionability before reading coordinates fixes that control. The original failure has the same disappearing title and transitional pointer geometry; the exact original scheduling is not replayed.
scope: Test synchronization only; no production runtime, public API, DOM/CSS, or installed package bytes changed.
limitations: Controlled Web Animation is intentional fault injection, not a claim about native transition duration.
Desktop browser engines and touch emulation are not physical devices.
CHAPTER-TIMING-01 and Chapter final integration/distribution tasks remain open.
No remote CI, full source-suite run, or npm publication.
